notes.title: March 2 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
- Added Goat Enemy
- Added Mountain Level Content and Bread
- Mole Enemy Bug Fixes
- Added Bouncing Rock Variation

notes.title: February 4th Patch
notes.notes:
- Added Controller Splash Screen
- Added Bread Placement for Several Levels
- Changed Background and polished Graphics on the first Mountain Level (press 3 in game to go there)
- General Bug Fixes and Features

notes.title: Jan 17 Patch 2
notes.notes:
-Added Several SFX to the Village Intro
-Ability to Change Volume of SFX in Village

notes.title: Jan 17th Patch
notes.notes:
-Fixed a crash related to a null reference for the rock weapon
-Add HUD icon for the Rock Weapon
-Restored default volume

notes.title: Jan 14 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
- Fixed Major issue of Keyboard and Mouse Input being taken over by the game
- Added some of the content of the last world levels

notes.title: Jan 8 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
- Added Collision to Levels Missing Collision in the Last World
- Fixed Crashing Bug involving Cloud Boss
- Fixed Options Menu sending you to the wrong intro
- Fixed the intro not having the feathers visible or tangible

notes.title: Update Notes New Year's Eve
notes.notes:
- Changed the level skip buttons to take you to the first levels of every world and the bosses of each world
- Fixed a bug where the player was able to fire their weapon while dead

notes.title: Update 12/20/2024
notes.notes:
- Added Village Music
- Fixed bug involving missing objects (specifically dust)
- Fixed bug where certain levels would crash on load
- Amended save / load system, fixes in progress
